ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) pixel distribution with high-intensity (white) localized clusters at the distal tips and lower margins, approximately 92:8 ratio.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity (white) contiguous clusters located on the lower-left ventral margin, the lower-right ventral margin extending upward, and at the extreme distal points of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute V-shaped depression with a sharp vertex and symmetrical divergent boundary lines.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency irregular serrations along the entire trailing edge boundary, characterized by at least 10 distinct pixel peaks of varying amplitudes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave-upward trajectory from the median notch transitioning into a broad convex curve toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Highly localized circular high-contrast pixel clusters (barnacles) situated on the extreme outer lateral edges of both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Dense barnacle colonization at the terminal ends of both fluke lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Asymmetrical white mottling pattern along the lower-right lobe margin.
